name: World Rules
description: Rules for each world: mobs breaking blocks, keeping your inventory on death, sleeping in beds, the day's length, the weather, natural monsters, monster light, apples from oak leaves, the falling hit bonus, bows that wear out. They run where the world runs, so a server can use them with any client. A world nobody changed plays as beta.
authors: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic's AI), at Studio Quire
